import numpy as np
best=[]
for w in np.linspace(0.05,3,600):
    A=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(P),P,P**2,t,np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t)])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    nm=np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    best.append((nm,w,c))
best.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
for b in best[:3]: print(b[0],b[1],np.round(b[2],3))
